verdict.rationale: Instinct is itself an autonomous personal-assistant agent, which is the MCP client role, so serving tools to other agents through an official MCP server is a different product role. Nothing in the evidence shows Instinct running as an MCP server: the vendor's sitemap and ToS show no API, MCP, CLI or developer surface. The Trusted People agent-to-agent feature is not an MCP server and does not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
